title: rosa glauca f. pennina
intro: Rosa glauca f. pennina, commonly known as Pennine Dog Rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa glauca, a type of rose plant known for its grayish-green foliage and fragrant flowers. The plant is used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues, due to its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties. Rosa glauca f. pennina is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions. The plant's therapeutic actions are believed to be due to the interaction of its bioactive constituents with the body's endocrine and nervous systems, promoting relaxation, reducing inflammation, and enhancing overall well-being.
